_backendSetupGuide._comment: PRODUCTION BACKEND SETUP — documentation only (JSON has no native comments).
_backendSetupGuide._step1_mock: Current config works for dev/preview with MockServer. ODataModel connects to /sap/opu/odata/sap/ZEB_MAILING_SRV/ which MockServer intercepts when window.USE_MOCK=true (see index.html).
_backendSetupGuide._step2_realBackend: For production: (a) set window.USE_MOCK=false in index.html; (b) publish SAP Gateway service ZEB_MAILING_SRV (SOAUTH / /IWFND/MAINT_SERVICE); (c) configure reverse proxy (sap-web-dispatcher/nginx/Caddy) mapping /sap/opu/odata/sap/ZEB_MAILING_SRV/ to backend port 8000; (d) replace UI5 CDN in index.html with local ABAP frontend server /sap/public/bc/ui5_ui5/ui5/1.71/resources/sap-ui-core.js.
_backendSetupGuide._step3_auth: SAP Gateway requires authentication. Same-origin (reverse proxy) uses SAP session cookie automatically. Cross-origin needs CORS + token auth.
_backendSetupGuide._step4_csrf: ODataModel v2 with useBatch=true auto-fetches CSRF token on first write. No manual handling needed.
_backendSetupGuide._step5_localUri: localUri (localService/metadata.xml) is MockServer-only. Production uses real $metadata from Gateway.
